topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I got these flowers today, and of course, there’s no card. Just a bunch of colorless petals like someone forgot the most basic part of the gesture. Who sends flowers without a note? It’s not like I don’t appreciate the thought, but what’s the point if I have no idea who’s behind it? I don’t need a mystery, I need answers. Now I’m left wondering if it’s a mistake, or if someone’s idea of a joke is to send me a question with no answer. I’ve got better things to do than play guessing games.
